name: Australian International School
summary: Dual Australian / IB pathways on Lorong Chuan — a common ANZA-orbit campus for Aussie continuity and broader internationals.
body: AIS combines Australian curriculum familiarity with IB Diploma options, serving a large Australian and wider international community on Lorong Chuan (north-east central, with access from Thomson and east corridors). Sport and outdoor culture are campus signatures. Families relocating from Australia often shortlist AIS alongside ANZA soft-landing calendars; treat waitlists and fee bands as live admissions questions, not brochure assumptions. Tour with commute maths from your actual housing shortlist — Lorong Chuan is not interchangeable with Woodlands SAS geography. Ask about learning-support capacity in writing if SEN is part of the household plan.
waitlistNotes: Popular entry years fill on rolling demand — contact admissions early; sibling priority policies vary.
